messages.text:
"Improve the existing game and make it feel like a polished superhero action RPG inspired by mobile hero-collection games.

Keep the current dark sci-fi visual style, circular battlefield, health bars, and skill-based combat system, but improve the gameplay and interface.

Core Gameplay

- Create a real-time action combat system with responsive character movement.
- Allow players to move, dodge enemy attacks, use basic attacks, and activate special skills.
- Add a team of three playable superheroes.
- Allow players to switch between the three characters during combat.
- Give each character unique abilities, animations, attack effects, and combat roles.
- Add cooldowns to special skills and an ultimate ability.

Character System

- Create a character selection screen with multiple playable heroes.
- Display each character's name, portrait, level, health, and abilities.
- Allow players to select and customize their team before entering a mission.
- Add character leveling and stat progression.

Mission System

- Create multiple stages with different enemies and environments.
- Make each mission consist of regular enemies followed by a powerful boss.
- Add mission objectives, victory conditions, and defeat conditions.
- Display a mission completion screen with rewards.

Combat UI

- Keep the player's health bar and the boss's health bar.
- Display the currently active character and the other two team members.
- Show skill icons, cooldown timers, and the ultimate skill.
- Add clear visual effects for attacks, damage, dodging, and skill activation.
- Make the interface responsive and suitable for mobile devices.

Important

Prioritize functional gameplay over decorative elements.
Ensure that character switching, movement, attacks, skills, enemy AI, and mission progression actually work.
Do not replace the existing game with a completely different concept.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Improve the existing dark sci-fi circular-arena game into a polished, playable superhero action RPG, retaining its combat style while adding a selectable three-hero team, switching, multiple missions, progression, and responsive controls.

## Requirements
- Functional movement, dodging, basic attacks, skills, cooldowns, ultimate, enemy AI, and mission progression.
- Character selection/customization, three-hero team, unique hero roles/abilities, leveling and stat progression.
- Multiple stages with enemy waves, a boss, objectives, victory/defeat outcomes, and rewards.
- Responsive mobile combat UI and clear combat effects; do not replace the game concept.
- Build directly without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Keep the existing `index.html` structure/styles and move toward replacing its inline JavaScript with a separate `game.js`.
- Use six heroes and three missions; default team is Aegis, Volt, and Bastion. Persist progression with `localStorage`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Read `index.html`, `README.md`, and `Agents.md`.
- Changed `index.html` to make the prior inline game script `type="text/plain"` and include `<script src="game.js"></script>`.
- Created `game.js` with hero/mission definitions, selection UI generation, basic UI styling, game state, team selection, mission setup, skill rendering, HUD updates, combat actions, enemy waves, and victory/defeat handling.

### Active
- `game.js` is incomplete: only initialization and functions through `missionLost()` are present; no game loop/rendering, enemy AI/hazards update, event/control bindings, or final boot invocation yet.
- Existing inline script remains in `index.html` as inert text and is superseded by `game.js`, but still contributes unnecessary content.
- Need verify the game in-browser and fix issues, including UI sizing and combat balance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue `game.js` with enemy AI, movement/update loop, rendering of the arena/heroes/enemies/projectiles/effects, and touch/keyboard/pointer controls.
2. Add boot/setup listeners, initialize the selection screen, and start the animation loop.
3. Run the game in a browser, test team selection/switching/combat/waves/boss/results/progression/mobile, and save/read the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Remove the inert old inline script from `index.html` if appropriate after verifying the replacement.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Existing page markup/styles; now loads `game.js` and leaves original script inert.
- `game.js`: New, currently incomplete implementation of the expanded game.

## Important Context
- User requested an actually playable game, not a decorative mockup; no validation or screenshot has been done yet.
- Changes are uncommitted.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Turn the existing dark sci-fi arena game into a polished, playable superhero action RPG while preserving its circular battlefield and skill-based combat.

## Requirements
- Implement movement, dodging, attacks, skills, cooldowns, ultimate, enemy AI, switching among three heroes, and mission progression.
- Include hero selection, distinct roles and abilities, leveling, missions with waves and bosses, objectives, outcomes, and rewards.
- Preserve the existing game concept and support mobile combat controls; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Keep the existing `index.html` structure and styles, with the replacement game in `game.js`.
- Plan for six selectable heroes, three missions, a default Aegis/Volt/Bastion team, and `localStorage` progression.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` marks the previous inline game script as inert `type="text/plain"` and loads `game.js`.
- `game.js` now contains hero and mission data, selection UI, combat setup, enemy AI, attacks and skills, switching, mission waves and boss, HUD, progression, rendering, and keyboard/touch controls.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Captured `/tmp/opencode/starfall.jpg` with headless Chromium and read the image.

### Active
- Browser-test the game and check for runtime errors and combat/UI issues.
- Remove the inert old inline script from `index.html` after verifying the replacement.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `/tmp/opencode/test-browser.cjs` to verify startup, combat input, HUD, and browser exceptions.
2. Test mission selection, team switching, wave transitions, boss and results, progression persistence, and mobile layout; fix any issues found.
3. Remove the inert old script from `index.html` once the replacement is confirmed working.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Replacement game implementation.
- `index.html`: Game markup/styles, inert old implementation, and `game.js` script include.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-browser.cjs`: Prepared Chromium DevTools smoke-test script; not yet run.
- `/tmp/opencode/starfall.jpg`: Headless Chromium screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The previous inline game implementation remains in `index.html` as inert script text.
- The game has not yet been verified through browser interaction.
